correctness.rationale: For the exact printed scheme, a and the Neumann coefficient are nonnegative because D>0 and u>=0. Since mu>=0, b_n>=b_0. The two displayed inequalities are respectively equivalent to c>=0 and b_0>=0. Forward spatial induction followed by time induction proves sufficiency for every nonnegative input. If either inequality fails, select an initial unit mass at node 2 (c<0) or at node 1 (b_0<0), zero boundary, and the node-1 result is negative at the first step. On the source mesh lambda=9 and b_0=-79941/100000; a prescribed finite profile with C_1^0=100, C_2^0=0 and the source inlet yields C_1^1<-54 for all three reported flows. Exact-fraction checks passed; no finite check is substituted for infinite induction.

originality.rationale: The accepted claim is the complete sharp universal-data, all-time positivity region for the exact 2026 printed biomass recurrence and an explicit failure witness under its reported mesh and parameters. Full primary text, two same-coauthor transport precursors, a 2020 sufficient monotonicity theorem, and alternative unconditional positivity methods were compared. Prior work supplies general positivity principles and related stencils but no inspected source establishes both sharp barriers plus this source-grid implication. Novelty is not claimed for general nonnegative-matrix theory and unindexed coverage remains a risk.

value.rationale: Nonnegative concentration is an essential invariant for biological biomass and meaningful phycoremediation planning; the named source represents modeled biomass this way. The result provides a full and inclusive two-obstruction classification for all nonnegative initial/boundary inputs, not an arbitrary finite numerical case; neither time-step reduction alone can repair a violated mesh-Péclet condition nor nutrient/light tuning alter the negative first-step b_0. The source’s published grid fails by a factor greater than eight and admits an explicit negative concentration, thereby exposing a material numerical-modeling risk. A source-specific sharp boundary is meaningful although the coefficient-sign proof is elementary and classical in general.
